general_world_news.title: 🌍 World News
general_world_news.content:
Here is your morning intelligence briefing, Pedro:

### WORLD NEWS

*   **Russia-Ukraine Conflict:** US President Donald Trump announced a three-day ceasefire in the Russia-Ukraine war, effective from May 9-11, including a prisoner exchange of 1,000 captives by each country. However, Al Jazeera reported that both sides traded fire despite the declared truce, and Russia scaled back its Victory Day celebrations. This development presents a fragile opportunity for de-escalation and humanitarian efforts, but the reported continued clashes underscore the persistent instability in the region, which continues to impact global energy prices and European security.

*   **US-Iran Tensions:** Tensions between the United States and Iran escalated with renewed clashes in the Strait of Hormuz, where the US reported attacking Iranian military sites in retaliation for alleged attacks on US Navy destroyers, while Iran accused the US of violating an existing ceasefire. This ongoing volatility in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global oil transit choke point, directly impacts international crude supply and prices, posing significant economic risks and exacerbating geopolitical instability in the Middle East.

*   **US-China Diplomacy:** US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are scheduled to meet in Beijing on May 14-15, with trade, US arms sales to Taiwan, and the ongoing Iran War expected to be key topics of discussion. This high-level summit is crucial for global economic stability and geopolitical relations, as potential agreements or disagreements on trade and security issues between the world's two largest economies will have broad implications for international markets, supply chains, and regional power dynamics.

Why it matters: Today's top stories highlight a period of acute geopolitical and economic uncertainty, with ceasefires proving fragile in major conflicts while the world's leading powers prepare for critical diplomatic engagements that could significantly reshape global trade and security landscapes.

portugal_policy.title: 🇵🇹 Portugal Policy & Law
portugal_policy.content:
Here is your morning intelligence briefing on Portugal's policy and law:

### PORTUGAL POLICY & LAW

*   **Revised Nationality Law:** The President promulgated a revised Nationality Law on May 3, 2026, which formally entered into force immediately. This law increases the residency requirement for acquiring Portuguese nationality to 7 years for citizens from the EU, Brazil, and Portuguese-speaking countries, and to 10 years for other nationalities, up from the previous 5-year period for all. It also stipulates that children born in Portugal to immigrant parents can only acquire nationality if at least one parent has been legally resident in the country for a minimum of five years, and it removes the special path to citizenship for descendants of Sephardic Jews. The practical impact is a significant tightening of access to Portuguese citizenship for various groups, requiring longer periods of legal residency and more stringent criteria. [cite: 5 from previous step, 15 from previous step, 18 from previous step, 19 from previous step]

*   **Rights of Young People in Health Transition (Lei n.º 19/2026):** Published on May 8, 2026, and entering into force today, May 9, 2026, this law strengthens the rights of young people transitioning from pediatric to adult health services. It mandates that this transition must be gradual and tailored to the patient's medical, psychosocial, and educational needs upon reaching adulthood. Furthermore, it explicitly recognizes the right to family accompaniment for young individuals who turn 18 while hospitalized, for a period deemed appropriate to their needs. This change provides enhanced protections and support for young adults navigating complex health system transitions. [cite: 9 from previous step]

*   **Strengthening of Forestry Rules (Lei n.º 18/2026):** Published on May 5, 2026, this law reinforces regulations concerning tree cutting and streamlines administrative offense regimes in forestry. It amends several existing decree-laws related to forestry management and conservation. The practical impact is stricter oversight and clearer penalties for activities within Portugal's forested areas, affecting landowners, forestry businesses, and environmental protection efforts.

*   **Pharmacy Operating Hours (Portaria n.º 209/2026/1):** Published on May 7, 2026, this ordinance amends previous regulations regarding the standard operating hours for community pharmacies. It defines the procedures for establishing, extending, executing, disseminating, and overseeing pharmaceutical assistance schedules, as well as setting the maximum fees pharmacies can charge for dispensing certain medicines and products outside of standard prescription times. This provides clarity for pharmacies on operational requirements and affects citizens' access to pharmaceutical services, especially during extended hours. [cite: 4 from previous step]

Why it matters: The most significant change for Portuguese citizens and businesses this week is the revised Nationality Law, which substantially alters the requirements and access to Portuguese citizenship, impacting individuals planning long-term residency and investment in the country.

ai_productivity.title: ⚡ AI & Productivity
ai_productivity.content:
Here's your morning intelligence briefing on AI & Productivity:

• **OpenAI:** Released new real-time voice models (GPT-Realtime-2, GPT-Realtime-Translate, GPT-Realtime-Whisper) in its API, featuring GPT-5-class reasoning, parallel tool calling, stronger recovery behavior, and an expanded context window of 128K tokens. Developers can now build more natural, intelligent, and responsive voice applications that communicate their actions, such as improving call success rates for customer service by 26 points. OpenAI Release Notes

• **xAI:** Made Grok 4.3 available on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Enterprise AI, offering a 1 million-token context window and strong performance across advanced logic, math, coding, and multi-step analysis (e.g., 98% on τ²-Bench Telecom). This allows enterprises to deploy xAI's latest frontier model for complex, cost-effective agentic AI applications. Oracle Blogs, xAI Docs

• **Adobe:** Launched a new Acrobat productivity agent, an AI assistant that enables users to chat with PDFs, extract insights, and generate new content types like presentations and social posts, utilizing tools across Acrobat Studio and Adobe Express Premium. This transforms static PDF interaction into a dynamic, collaborative workspace, saving hours of manual analysis and content creation from documents. Solutions Review, Adobe

• **Notion:** Shipped "Plan Mode" for Custom Agents, a new Custom Agent Directory, and expanded admin controls with credit limits and usage dashboards, while also reducing Custom Agent run costs by 35-50% with new cheaper models. These updates make Notion's AI agents more predictable, manageable, and cost-effective for automating complex workflows and team busywork within the workspace. Notion Release Notes

• **Perplexity:** Integrated Morningstar and PitchBook data through Model Context Protocol (MCP), and updated Perplexity Computer with GPT-5.5 as the default orchestration model, enterprise features like Teams access, and Snowflake/Databricks data workflows. This empowers users, especially in finance and enterprise, to conduct more reliable, deeply integrated, and comprehensive research with trusted, real-time data directly within Perplexity's AI platform. Perplexity Changelog, Las Vegas Sun News

Why it matters: The continuous evolution of agentic capabilities and specialized data integrations is making AI tools more practical, controllable, and deeply embedded in professional workflows, reducing manual effort and enhancing decision-making.

eu_policy.title: 🇪🇺 European Union Policy
eu_policy.content:
• **AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689):** Providers of "High-Risk" AI systems must now complete the implementation of mandatory quality management systems, technical documentation, and human oversight mechanisms before the final application deadline. This applies to all entities deploying AI for credit scoring, recruitment, or critical infrastructure. High compliance costs will specifically pressure Portuguese tech startups and financial institutions integrating AI into lending. EUR-Lex

• **Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD):** Listed SMEs are now required to publish their first sustainability reports based on the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) for the 2025 financial year. Reports must include audited data on carbon footprints and workforce diversity. This significantly increases the administrative and auditing burden for mid-cap companies listed on the Euronext Lisbon. European Commission

• **Nature Restoration Law:** Member States must formally submit their finalized National Restoration Plans to the Commission, detailing binding targets to restore 20% of EU land and sea areas by 2030. The plans must include specific zoning for peatland and forest restoration. This will likely lead to new land-use restrictions and potential compensation schemes for agricultural investors in rural Portugal. EUR-Lex

• **MiFIR Consolidated Tape (Decision/Technical Standards):** The operational launch of the Consolidated Tape for bonds is now imminent, requiring trading venues to provide real-time trade and quote data to a single centralized provider. This mandates a standardized data reporting format for all EU bond markets. Portuguese institutional investors will benefit from increased price transparency and reduced spreads in the corporate bond market. ESMA

Why it matters: The convergence of the AI Act's high-risk deadlines and the CSRD's expansion to SMEs marks a transition from legislative approval to a heavy operational compliance phase for EU businesses.
